shell.changelog: v0.3 (2026-11-12): the person's guide ships inside the viewer (skills/brain-viewer/guide/) and the shell agrees with it: CLAUDE.md maps each phrase the guide teaches to what it does, lists the open tasks at boot and logs through skills/brain-log/log.py (no typed timestamps); one starting project, projects/getting-started/ with its task list, named in the new context/holon-registry.json, and SETUP writes a first-week list on it; context/claude-task-queue.md removed; SETUP's app step optional and read-only; WHAT-YOU-GET.md points at the guide; SHELL.md lists what the kit installs and says no hooks ship. v0.2 (2026-08-28): standing reminders live in the 📌 section of context/current-focus.md (standing-reminders.md dropped); dispatcher-cursor.md dropped (a dispatcher install creates its own); Ferret removed from the sync-adapter list; 4-state-file pattern documented in context/readme.md. v0.1: structure default (folder skeleton + per-folder readmes + SETUP/SHELL/WHAT-YOU-GET + CLAUDE.md with {{INHABITANT}} placeholders), cast 2026-07-09.
shell.source: local:brain-shell (resolved by assemble-brain.py on the maintainer machine; informational only)
shell.note: Assembler clones this, then installs the skills below. Versioned here so structure updates can propagate like skill updates. Phase 2: host the shell + serve via GET /api/v1/pack.

skills.changelog: REQUIRED: summaries stay on this computer. Every push step is removed (the push note, the push payload wording, the re-push and correction rules); the owner rules no longer depend on the app's import (an owner is me or one person's full name, never a collective); people cards stay on this computer. Preset Parity, the five headers, the People fold and the verbatim check are unchanged.
skills.blurb: processes your meeting/mentor-call transcripts into app-matching summaries + action items (preset parity) that stay on this computer; answers questions about transcripts; surfaces prompts discussed in calls; runs the mandatory People fold into `people/` cards after every transcript.

skills.changelog: REQUIRED: nothing is sent to the PF App any more. Your calls, transcripts and summaries stay on this computer. push.py sends nothing: run in any way it prints one line ('Nothing sent: your transcripts and summaries stay on this computer.') and exits 0, without opening the token file or making a network call. The intake runbook is five steps (file, extract, fold, log, verify) with no push, no landing check and no pull after it; pipeline-verify.py no longer looks for a pushed record (check 4 retired) and takes BRAIN_ROOT; ferryman-skill.md and ferryman-rules.md describe a read-only mirror. pull.py and the adapter contract unchanged.
skills.blurb: read-only connection between your PF App account (your own personal token) and your local app mirror: STATUS/PULL via `pull.py`. Nothing goes from your brain to the app; push.py sends nothing. `pipeline-verify.py` checks the transcript pipeline. Intake procedure: [[skills/ferryman/transcript-intake-runbook.md]].

skills.changelog: Facet registry v2: career-arc joins the base facets (optional, senior/partner/mentor cards mainly). people.py unchanged.
skills.blurb: the machine door to `people/` cards — `people.py --list` (frontmatter facets), `--get <slug>` (shareable/full tiers, [private] always stripped), `--verify` (schema + fold checks against `people/facets.json`). People cards NEVER push to the app — brain-side only.

skills.changelog: Folder components: a manifest entry carrying update: replace-folder and an installRoot (the Brain Viewer is the first) is installed and updated WHOLE by the new skills/update/install-component.py (download, sha256 check, copy the entry's keepBeforeReplace files into the user layer, swap the folder, one log line), never merged. Everything else still updates by prompt.
skills.blurb: checks the pf-pack manifest for newer skill versions and applies update prompts on your yes; installs and updates folder components (the Brain Viewer) whole with install-component.py.

skills.changelog: The guide to your brain now comes with the viewer: a start page, a day with your brain with what to say to Claude at each point, your brain part by part, and a short presentation of what it can do. Today opens it from one line near the top until you press got it, and from How your brain works at the foot of the page after that. Also since 0.114.0: in a Forge drawing, lines no longer pass through cells they do not connect and words no longer sit on each other; dropping an Output on a cell selects it; and the pages for a second agent working beside Claude, drawn only on a computer set up for one.
skills.blurb: the Brain Viewer: a local app over your brain (home board of widgets, today, projects, people, the reader, canvases and maps). An application, replaced whole on update; what you make for it lives in viewer/ and is never touched.
